children: Dianomi, a digital advertising provider specializing in the business, finance, and lifestyle sectors. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Dianomi connects high-intent audiences with over 600 premium advertisers, including major financial institutions such as Charles Schwab, Invesco, and Bank of America through ad inventory across major publishers including Reuters, CNN Business, The Times, and The Wall Street Journal.
The acquisition is set to strengthen Taboola’s finance-focused ad capabilities by integrating Dianomi’s publisher network into its AI-powered Realize platform.

By combining Dianomi’s brand-safe environments with Taboola’s first-party data and supply, performance advertisers gain expanded reach to high-intent business, finance, and lifestyle audiences at scale.
The deal is expected to close before the end of 2026, subject to customary regulatory approvals and Dianomi shareholder consent.

title: Taboola expands finance vertical with agreement to acquire Dianomi
